title: Report the configured request body limit accurately
problem: BodyLimit accepts max_bytes but its HTTP 413 message always says 1 MiB. A custom limit therefore reports an incorrect limit.
acceptance_criteria: The default limit preserves the existing public 1 MiB error wording and request_too_large code.
A custom limit of 8 bytes rejects 9 bytes and accurately reports the configured byte limit, without exposing the request contents.
Exactly max_bytes is accepted. Count bytes across multiple ASGI chunks, including multibyte UTF-8 input.
Rejection does not call the downstream app. Accepted chunks are replayed intact exactly once; disconnect behavior and non-body-method passthrough are preserved.
Add self-contained async middleware regression tests using synthetic input; no network or model calls.
exclusions: No other middleware redesign, dependency updates, API changes, UI work, or existing-test edits.
